observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a dark gray iPhone with a single rear camera and a small flash, showing the back with the Apple logo. The background has a sign reading 'GENUINE DEVICES PLUG'.

Photo 1: The iPhone screen shows the Battery Health settings: Maximum Capacity 94%, Cycle Count 350, Manufacture Date September 2026 (likely a typo, as 2026 is in the future), and First Use November 2026 (also likely a typo).
Photo 2: A clearer back view of the same iPhone, showing the single camera module and Apple logo. The phone appears to be an iPhone 12 or 13 mini model due to the camera design and size.
The phone has a notch on the front screen, consistent with iPhone models from 2017 onward.
The seller claims it is an 'iPhone Air 256gb eSIM unlocked' — 'iPhone Air' is not a real model name; likely a misnomer for iPhone 12/13 mini or similar.
